source_semantics: Isolated space managing users credentials roles groups clients and configuration
important_relations_or_lifecycle: contains/manages users groups roles clients; user logs into one realm
semantic_risk: Realm is not IdentityContext and not TrustDomain

source_semantics: Locally managed user identity/account record in realm
important_relations_or_lifecycle: belongs to realm; has credentials; groups; role mappings; sessions; federated links
cm4di_target: CM4DI-C1001 Account; C1002 UserProfile; C0002 IdentitySubject via representation relation
semantic_risk: Do not equate Keycloak User row with real-world subject

source_semantics: Password/passkey/TOTP/etc credential associated with user authentication
important_relations_or_lifecycle: owned/managed for user; used by authentication flow; reset/update lifecycle
cm4di_target: CM4DI-C0018 Authenticator and/or C0011 Credential depending mechanism
semantic_risk: Keycloak 'credential' spans ontologically heterogeneous artifacts

source_semantics: Realm or client-level authorization role assignable directly or through groups; may be composite
important_relations_or_lifecycle: mapped to user/group; composite includes roles; emitted in tokens
semantic_risk: IAM Role is not UFO Role; role may bundle permissions rather than represent contextual entity role

source_semantics: Role associated with other roles; assignments inherit nested roles
important_relations_or_lifecycle: includes child roles; user mapping inherits composition
semantic_risk: Do not infer subclass hierarchy from role composition

source_semantics: Mapping between user and zero or more roles
important_relations_or_lifecycle: user assigned role; grants role-derived capabilities
semantic_risk: Assignment is not runtime authorization decision

source_semantics: Grouping of users with attributes and role mappings
important_relations_or_lifecycle: user memberOf group; group has attributes and roles; member inherits mappings
semantic_risk: Not a social group or organizational unit by default

source_semantics: User membership in Keycloak group
important_relations_or_lifecycle: membership causes inherited attributes/role mappings
semantic_risk: Membership is distinct from identity equality and from organization membership

source_semantics: OIDC/SAML relying application/service configuration in realm
important_relations_or_lifecycle: has protocol/settings/scopes/service account; participates in sessions
semantic_risk: Client configuration is not software Application entity itself

source_semantics: Built-in account for a client to obtain tokens
important_relations_or_lifecycle: associated with client; assigned roles; authenticates client credentials
semantic_risk: Service account is account representation, not workload entity

source_semantics: External IdP used for delegated authentication
important_relations_or_lifecycle: broker connects realm to external IdP; maps incoming claims; may link account
cm4di_target: C1003 IdentitySource when information-source role applies; FederationConnection/IdentityBroker otherwise
semantic_risk: IdP is not always IdentitySource; source role depends on information provenance use

source_semantics: Intermediary connecting service providers and external identity providers
important_relations_or_lifecycle: delegates authentication; creates/links internal account from external identity
semantic_risk: Broker role is contextual, not rigid system kind

source_semantics: Internal account linked to one or more identities from external identity providers
important_relations_or_lifecycle: links local user/account with external provider identity
semantic_risk: Link does not prove identity equality; provenance and unlink lifecycle matter

source_semantics: Connects Keycloak to LDAP/AD or custom external user storage
important_relations_or_lifecycle: validates credentials; pulls/synchronizes user identity information
cm4di_target: C1003 IdentitySource; C1005 IdentityStore; C1013 ProvisioningConnection
semantic_risk: User federation/storage federation is not identity-provider federation

source_semantics: Maps external IdP tokens/assertions into user/session attributes
important_relations_or_lifecycle: transforms incoming claims to local attributes/session
semantic_risk: Mapping artifact should preserve source provenance

source_semantics: Created when user logs in; tracks login and participating clients
important_relations_or_lifecycle: created by successful login; includes client sessions; timeout/logout/revoke lifecycle
semantic_risk: Session is not AuthenticationResult; likely needs explicit establishedBy relation/lifecycle

source_semantics: Workflow specifying authenticators/actions for login, registration or reset
important_relations_or_lifecycle: contains executions/required actions; produces successful/failed interaction
semantic_risk: Flow definition is not same as Authentication event instance

source_semantics: Action user must complete before authentication process can complete
important_relations_or_lifecycle: update password/verify email/etc; blocks completion until satisfied
semantic_risk: Do not create generic Core class until cross-source convergence

source_semantics: Maps user attributes/roles into OIDC token or SAML assertion
important_relations_or_lifecycle: transforms local information into outgoing claims/assertions
semantic_risk: Protocol mapping is representation transformation, not evidence by itself

source_semantics: Realm-scoped organization construct for B2B/multi-organization identity
important_relations_or_lifecycle: memberships, IdP association and organization-aware login
cm4di_target: W3C ORG + CM4DI Identity Administration/Federation bridge
semantic_risk: Avoid inventing generic organization ontology inside CM4DI

source_semantics: Resource represented in Keycloak Authorization Services
important_relations_or_lifecycle: has scopes; targeted by policies/permissions
semantic_risk: Configuration resource may be representation of actual protected resource

source_semantics: Scope represents operation or access dimension over resource
important_relations_or_lifecycle: associated with resource and scope permissions
semantic_risk: Keycloak scope may not equal executed Action instance

source_semantics: Policy defines conditions for granting access
important_relations_or_lifecycle: evaluated by permission/decision strategy
semantic_risk: Policy language specifics remain implementation layer

source_semantics: Permission associates protected resource/scope with policies
important_relations_or_lifecycle: resource/scope permission evaluated to decision
semantic_risk: Keycloak Permission object combines normative permission and policy evaluation configuration

source_semantics: Administrative changes to managed objects can be logged as events
important_relations_or_lifecycle: create/update/delete/admin operations with actor/context
semantic_risk: Audit event is evidence/provenance, not domain lifecycle event by default
